name: aspg-weekly-harvest
description: ASPG Weekly Harvest — scans the last 7 days of Outlook/Calendar/Teams for shareable customer, partner, and opportunity signals, and renders a review page (checkboxes, editable wording) with a one-click Contribute button (plain-connector-name MCP addressing), falling back per-row to a paste-back-to-chat step, instead of copy-pasting the original starter prompt every week.
